thread_counter_accounting.graph_boundary_method: Proportional overlap of each approximately one-second counter interval with completed native graph frames; assumes uniform CPU accrual in interval.

missing_fields.reason: PhaseCanaries accumulated phase_summaries in memory; protected harness finally serialized only numeric_summaries with ten base fields. Full phase fields are absent from retained server logs and client JSON.

limitations: One completed instrumented synthetic task. The historical 1175-to-current 771-second difference cannot be assigned to a software change or instrumentation; untouched original CLI current fixed control already reached 3.753 tok/s.
Current final response is 20 tokens longer than the historical run; earlier requests retain the same token/prompt counts, but this is not byte-identical whole-task output.
Vec-dot classification includes F32/BF16/F16 plus quantized formats. Leaf user CPU samples cannot isolate inlined dequantization/unpack arithmetic or identify tensor/layer.

User CPU sample core-time estimates omit kernel/system time, sleep and I/O wait. Thread-counter phase allocations are estimates; exiting-thread tails are lost and boundary intervals assume uniform accrual.
Host per-core utilization includes other processes; no owned-thread residency/affinity or clock-frequency trace exists.
Outer trace FileReader.read latency includes staging/setup/copy; native syscall-only lane metrics were not serialized. Summed lane elapsed is nonadditive and cannot recover exposed SSD wait.
Cache hits are lookup-count weighted, not byte-weighted; prefill lookups count staged batch expert requests rather than every input-token assignment.
Reference QDs are sequential 1 MiB repeated-window filesystem O_DIRECT traffic, not physical NAND limits. Whole-graph throughput/reference ratios are not SSD utilization or attainable speedups.

No numerical expected-gain-per-benchmark-hour forecast is justified. Approximately four minutes is only a current fixed-pair execution-cost reference, excluding setup, repeats and full-agent qualification.
The 14.4% idealized decode 4-to-6 whole-task reduction is arithmetic under complete linear decode scaling, not an expected gain or observed effect.
CPU quota/throttle and PSI phase histories were not retained for this protected trial; zero memory/pids events cannot establish zero CPU throttling.
curation: Finite numeric fields, known library function basenames, fixed labels and SHA256 identities only; excludes prompts, outputs, final text, private paths, PIDs, job IDs, addresses and raw samples.
attribution_incomplete_reason: Exact native exposed wait, cache management, inner syscall-lane and residual clocks were not serialized.
cpu_symbol_normalization: Known ggml C++ template/clone symbols grouped by plain ggml function basename; template arguments, addresses, offsets and arbitrary strings excluded.

io_clock_source_evidence.trace_scope: Outer read_slice clock surrounds complete FileReader.read, including staging/bounce-buffer setup and final memcpy.
io_clock_source_evidence.native_overlap_io_scope: stats sums FileReader.syscall_ns, whose inner clock surrounds the positioned-read loop and stops before final memcpy; bounce-buffer setup occurs before the inner clock.
io_clock_source_evidence.numeric_examples_scope: separate fixed-code pair only; full-agent inner/native clocks were not serialized
